playStore.title: Gravita: Rep Counter
playStore.shortDescription: Camera rep counting that only counts a rep when it sees you actually did it.

description:
Gravita counts your reps from your phone's camera — and only counts one when it can actually see you did the movement. Stand up out of a squat without going deep, or bounce your arms without bending your elbows, and it won't count. That's the whole idea: a rep counter you can trust, not one that counts anything that looks vaguely like movement.

WHAT IT DOES
- Counts reps on-device, from your camera, in real time
- Each rep is checked against the joint movement it actually requires before it counts
- Works fully offline — nothing about your camera feed ever leaves your phone

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
- It does not grade your form. It counts correctly-performed reps; it does not score how good they looked.
- Nothing corrects you while you train. There is no live coaching voice or on-screen cue mid-set.
- It is not medical software, and it is not a substitute for a coach. It cannot stop you from falling or getting hurt — you're responsible for training within your own ability.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT'S READY
Gravita's library covers 31 movements across squats, pushes, pulls, core, and more. Today, 2 of them — the bodyweight squat and the push-up — have a fully measured identity check behind their rep count. The rest are visible in the library and marked plainly as still waiting on that same measurement before they open. We'd rather show you an honest "not yet" than a rep count we can't stand behind.

PRIVACY
All processing happens on your device. No account, no video upload, no cloud analysis.

Gravita is a movement-practice tool, not a medical device.

Sayilar bugun olculdu (python3 -c "json.load(open('content/library.json'))", 2026-08-16): 31 toplam, canli yalniz bodyweight_squat + push_up (ikisinin de derived precondition kapisi var — squat: hip-diz Pearson korelasyonu, push_up: torso_angle_from_vertical, M-F-38-PILOT-RAPORU.md). ✅ H-58 (orkestratör, 2026-08-16): bu not yalniz DUZYAZIYDI, sifir okuyucusu vardi — artik tools/validate_store_listing.py run_all_gates.sh'in SUIT 3'unde bu sayilari content/library.json'in GERCEK sayimina karsi sinar (bu dosya + STORE-LISTING-TASLAK.md'nin ikisi de), hasat turu ilerleyip metin guncellenmezse KIRMIZI yanar. Bayatlama artik SESSIZ olamaz.

Cihaz-performansi/upload/submit iddiasi tasimaz — B7 kurucu kalemi. 'Coach'/'training plan'/'personal trainer' gibi hizmet-vaadi kelimeleri KULLANILMADI (valueWhatWeDont'un yasakladigi tam sinif).

cameraPermissionRationale.ios: Gravita watches you while you train to count your reps and time your tempo. Video stays on this device and is never uploaded — and nothing from the camera is stored, not even body landmarks. What gets saved is your session: which movement, how many reps, and how long.
cameraPermissionRationale.$source: ios/Runner/Info.plist NSCameraUsageDescription — BURAYA KOPYALANDI, DEGISTIRILMEDI. DUZELTILDI (2026-08-16, orkestrator sevki ②): eski metin 'watches your push-ups' diyordu — squat da bugun canli ama cumle onu adlandirmiyordu (H-44 sinifinda bir eskime-beyaniydi, adiyla bulunup bu turda kapatildi). Yeni metin hareket adi ICERMIYOR ('while you train') - hangi hareketin canli oldugu DEGISTIKCE bu cumlenin YENIDEN bayatlamasi yapisal olarak IMKANSIZ, cunku artik ozel bir sayi/ad tasimiyor.
